finding: UNTESTABLE under the mandated HIDOOK_TEST_PAY=1 environment: POST /api/test-pay/complete (bot/server.js#handleTestPayComplete) calls and awaits webpublish.handleStripePaid() synchronously in the SAME request/response cycle -- there is no webhook round-trip and no polling loop in builder/app.js for the offline test-pay path. The real /webhooks/stripe HTTP route (used only with a real STRIPE_SECRET_KEY+STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET) DOES ack 200 immediately and process the event asynchronously afterward (confirmed above in TRW-11d), so a delayed-webhook scenario is structurally possible in production, but cannot be driven end-to-end without live Stripe test-mode credentials, which this exploration is forbidden from using.
